summary: MicroVision, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 6,800,000 shares of common stock paired with warrants to purchase up to 6,800,000 shares at a combined public offering price of $2.50 per unit, totaling $17 million gross proceeds. The warrants are immediately exercisable at $2.50 per share with a five-year term. The offering price represents a 33.7% discount to the August 13, 2026 closing price of $3.77. WestPark Capital acted as placement agent, receiving a 6.5% cash fee. The issuer will receive net proceeds of approximately $15.9 million. This is a dilutive equity capital raise with warrant overhang; watch for subsequent warrant exercises and potential dilution.
